name: Ownership
summary: Ownership from the ASSET's point of view (Ownership). Three layers — business leaders (Business Owner: groups of assets/apps), technology owners (Owner: routes & paths, from Exposure Routes), and a single complete Asset Owner who owns an asset's every open finding (or 'the rest'). Ownership is counted on plugins — an asset's open findings — with routes and paths as the ways they're assigned (own a route and its paths are covered). Shows per-asset ownership %, what's unclaimed / blind, crown jewels (ACR >= 9) and what the Ensemble already know about them, mitigated/accepted/ignored share, and assigns owners from plain English that reads each asset's tags. All writes gated.

widgets.title: Crown jewels without an owner
widgets.note: ACR ≥ 9 assets with no Owner tag — the accountability gap that matters most.
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Unowned crown jewels" FROM assets a WHERE $__crown(a) AND $__scope(a.uuid) AND a.uuid NOT IN (SELECT asset_uuid FROM tags WHERE tag_key='Owner' AND asset_uuid IS NOT NULL)
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address) AS host, a.ip_address AS ip, a.operating_system, a.acr, a.uuid AS asset_uuid FROM assets a WHERE $__crown(a) AND $__scope(a.uuid) AND a.uuid NOT IN (SELECT asset_uuid FROM tags WHERE tag_key='Owner' AND asset_uuid IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY host
